news.title: New Max Level Weekly Quest Rewards Up to 100 Gold in WoW: Forever
news.description: Once you reach max level in WoW: Forever, there's a new Weekly Quest that awards a random amount of gold, up to 100 Gold!
news.details:
There have been some changes to the Gold Economy in WoW: Forever, from the Experience to Gold conversion being disabled, extra Quest Gold for higher level quests, the Auction House Deposit being increased to 1 Silver temporarily on launch, and more. Another change is a new quest for players who reach the max level of 60.
Located in Booty Bay, In Demand - Ancient Elven Curiosities is offered to level 60 players every week. For the two weeks that the game has been active, the quest has been the same both times: collect three items from the three wings of Dire Maul. This quest may change in the future, as we've only seen two weekly resets so far.
Once you've completed all three Dire Maul wings and looted all the items, turn in the quest back in Booty Bay to be awarded a Undermine Satchel. This Satchel contains one item that vendors for Gold and some other materials. The Gold item can…

news.title: Learning Dual Spec Can Trigger Empty Action Bars When Logging Out in WoW: Forever
news.description: Once you learn Dual Spec, a bug can randomly trigger when you log out, wiping abilities off your Action Bars!
news.details:
Dual Spec can be purchased at level 40 for 50 Gold, allowing you to have a secondary talent tree. However, once you learn Dual Spec, there's an annoying bug that can occur whenever you log out.
For some reason, after you learn Dual Spec, you can randomly have some of your Action Bars reset after you log out. This doesn't always seem to be the case, and it can happen to different bars every time. While this doesn't affect combat capabilities, it can be annoying to log in and see a bar completely reset.
Screenshot Credit: Reloe. After logging in, the top-left bars are missing (Left Image) and have to be reimported (Right Image).
Due to this bug, many players have downloaded the Myslot addon. This addon was designed to help you save and import your UI across accounts, PCs, or on a new alt, but this addon has become very useful for filling your missing Action Bars every time they reset due…

news.title: Season of Discovery's Scarlet Enclave Raid to Return in WoW: Forever
news.description: In the latest episode of the WoW: Forever podcast, Blizzard has confirmed that the SoD exclusive raid, The Scarlet Enclave, will eventually return in WoW: Forever!
news.details:
When discussing the potential favorite characters, lore, and stories to bring into the WoW: Forever universe, Aggrend brought up some of his personal favorites, including the Season of Discovery exclusive raid: The Scarlet Enclave.
"I mentioned Vol'jin; I think that's one I'm really excited to dive into, but I've been fortunate enough that I've been able to touch the Ashbringer a little bit, you know... Scarlet Enclave will return. The Ashbringer will return at some point; it might be a while, but that's going to come back."
Along with the Scarlet Enclave, the story of The Ashbringer will also return, potentially along with this raid, "at some point" in WoW: Forever. news.title: New High Level Battle Mage Weapon Discovered in WoW: Forever
news.description: Players have discovered a new high-level Battle Mage weapon called Wit's Edge in WoW: Forever!
news.details:
Battle Mage is an archetype of mage that tends to use spells and melee attacks to defeat their foes. This hasn't been supported in past World of Warcraft, as Mage is traditionally a ranged DPS. With a new level 60 weapon discovered in WoW: Forever, Battle Mages may have some potential at max level!
This weapon provides some spell power and spell piercing, but also has a very unique effect: Wit's End. On a melee swing, there's a 15% chance for the Mage to gain Clearcasting. This could lead to some interesting rotations, where Mages want to weave in some melee swings between swings to get free casts.
How to Obtain Wit's End Weapon
Wit's Edge is an item created by using a Scroll of Wit on the Witchblade.
Scroll of Wit can be discovered through a Mage's comprehension skill on the level 175 skill scrolls, according to Reddit user Kissta96.

news.title: Enhancement Shaman Class Changes Now Live in WoW: Forever
news.description: Blizzard has confirmed that the Enhancement Shaman changes are now live.
news.details:
Enhancement Shaman Guide
Please note:
Due to an unexpected delay in deployment, the following changes went live to all regions at 10:45 a.m. PST today.
Classes
Shaman
Weapon imbues and Weapon totems can now be used at the same time.
Enhancement
Stormstrike damage reduced to 100% weapon damage (was 150%), and cooldown increased to 8 seconds (was 6 seconds).
Mental Dexterity: Intellect to Attack Power conversion ratio reduced to 33/66/100% (was 50/100/150%).
Maelstrom Weapon now grants 20% reduced cast time and Mana cost per application at all ranks (was 4/8/12/16/20% reduced cast time and Mana cost), and chance to activate now increases with rank and activates 6/7/8/9/10 times per minute (was 20 times per minute regardless of rank).

news.title: "Start Making Other Arrangements" - Josh Greenfield on Locking Character Creation on PvP Rulesets
news.description: In episode 7 of the WoW: Forever podcast, Josh Greenfield comments on locking character creation on PvP rulesets, noting that Horde players who have not made a character on most PvP and RP-PVP realms should "start…
news.details:
A few days ago, Blizzard announced that they are addressing overall faction balance on PvP servers. To do this, they made it harder to create a character on the more popular faction on PvP and RP-PVP realms, most of which are Horde. In the most recent podcast episode, Josh Greenfield (Aggrend) recommends that players who are looking to roll on those most populous factions should "start making other arrangements." This likely indicates that this faction lock will be in place for a longer period of time.
We've kind of tightened it up a little bit. Unfortunately, that means if you haven't made a Horde character, you're going to want to start making other arrangements at this point because we kind of had to clamp that down.

news.title: Loot Ocarina of Time Boots from Drowned City in WoW: Forever
news.description: A pair of boots has been discovered in the Drowned City loot table, which appears to be a clear reference to The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time!
news.details:
With Nintendo's recently released remaster of this iconic game for the Switch 2, it looks like Blizzard developers want to show some love for this game. According to our database, these boots can drop off of any boss within the new dungeon in WoW Forever: The Drowned City.
In The Legend of Zelda games, players acquire Iron Boots that allow players to walk at the bottom of bodies of water, but only walk slowly on land. According to this post on Reddit, when players equip these boots in WoW Forever, they'll mimic the same features!
This isn't the first reference to The Legend of Zelda in World of Warcraft, as the character Linken has existed since World of Warcraft's creation back in 2004. Players in Un'Goro Crater can unlock a series of quests by discovering It's a Secret to Everybody, leading players to get the powerful Linken's Sword of Mastery (the Master Sword!)

news.title: Party with Other Players to Use Their Sleeping Bags for Experience Buff in WoW: Forever
news.description: Getting the Cozy Sleeping Bag takes a long time, but you can use other players' sleeping bags to get the same experience buff if you're in the same party!
news.details:
Cozy Sleeping Bag Guide
The Cozy Sleeping Bag is an item added to WoW: Forever that grants an experience buff for 2 hours. For every minute that you spend lying down in the sleeping bag, you'll get a 1% experience buff, which stacks up to 3 times for a 3% bonus experience. Getting the Sleeping Bag takes you on an adventure across multiple zones and can take around 1 to 2 hours, which is a pretty significant investment.
For players who don't want to farm the Sleeping Bag, you can actually get cozy in another person's sleeping bag. If you see someone using a sleeping bag on the floor, you can ask them to join their party and use it to get the buff.
